Counsel for Applicant :- Dhirendra Vikram Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. No one appears on behalf of the respondent no.2 despite service of notice.

3. In terms of the F.I.R. which was lodged as a missing person report alleging therein that the sister of the informant aged about 19 years, was enticed away by the applicant. Subsequently, the victim stated that she had gone alongwith the applicant out of her own free will and physical relations were also formed in between them.
Nothing wrong was alleged against the applicant.

4. 1 also formed.

entities.text: Raju vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The applicant is languishing in jail since 19.11.2023 having no criminal antecedents,
hence the applicant may be released on bail.
5. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail.

6. Considering the age of the victim to be 19 years and statement recorded by the victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C. does not support the prosecution story coupled with the fact that the applicant is in jail since 19.11.2023 and has no criminal antecedents, and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
7.
Accordingly, the application for grant of bail is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Raju be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.0409 of 2023, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act, Police Station Makhi, District Unnao on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions :-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
